faqHeroSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our private chauffeur services in the United States.
faqQ1: How is Black Suit Car different from rideshare apps (Uber / Lyft)?
faqA1: Unlike rideshare apps with random drivers and fluctuating surge rates, Black Suit Car is a dedicated, white-glove private chauffeur service. You receive a guaranteed luxury black SUV or sedan, a vetted professional driver in executive attire, flight tracking with complimentary wait time, and fixed upfront pricing with zero cancellations.
faqA2: We operate exclusively within the United States, providing private airport transfers, city-to-city rides, corporate travel, and hourly chauffeur services in major metropolitan areas.
faqQ3: How do airport pickups and flight tracking work?
faqA3: We monitor your flight status in real time. If your flight is delayed or arrives early, your chauffeur automatically adjusts the pickup schedule. For airport transfers, we include complimentary wait time and meet you at the designated terminal pickup area.
faqQ4: What are your operating hours and can I book outside standard hours?
faqA4: Our standard operating hours are 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM Eastern Time (ET). Transportation services outside these hours (late night or early dawn) are available upon advance reservation and prior approval.
faqQ5: How is pricing calculated? Are there hidden fees or surge pricing?
faqA5: Our pricing is transparent and all-inclusive. You will receive a fixed rate before confirming your ride, with no surge pricing, hidden taxes, or surprise fees.
faqQ6: What vehicles are in your fleet?
faqA6: Our fleet features late-model luxury Black Ford Expedition Max SUVs with premium perforated leather seating, tri-zone climate control, privacy glass, Wi-Fi, and complimentary refreshments.
faqA7: You can cancel or reschedule your ride with advance notice. Please contact our team as early as possible to adjust your booking without penalty.
faqQ8: Can I request special accommodations (child seats, extra luggage)?
faqA8: Yes! You can specify any special requests (child booster/car seats, extra luggage capacity, flight details, or specific route preferences) in the Special Requests field when booking.
faqCtaText: Our concierge team is available daily from 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET to assist you.
termsHeroSubtitle: Please review our terms of service and transportation guidelines for Black Suit Car.
termsSec1Text: By requesting, booking, or using the ground transportation services provided by Black Suit Car, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. Black Suit Car operates exclusively as a private chauffeur service within the United States. We are not a public rideshare pool, and all bookings are subject to confirmation and driver availability.
termsSec2Text: Our standard daily operating hours are from 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM Eastern Time (ET). Reservation requests submitted through our website are reviewed between 7:00 AM and 9:00 PM ET. Transportation services outside standard hours (late night or early morning) must be requested in advance and are subject to prior approval.
termsSec3Text: Black Suit Car operates on a transparent, fixed upfront pricing model. Rates are calculated based on route distance, vehicle class, estimated time, and any requested extra stops. We do not apply unpredictable surge pricing. Applicable highway tolls and airport parking fees are outlined prior to booking confirmation.
termsSec4Text: Reservations may be canceled or rescheduled without penalty when notice is provided at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled pickup time. For airport transfers, flight status is monitored in real time; complimentary wait time is provided starting from the actual flight landing time (up to 45 minutes for domestic flights and 60 minutes for international flights).
termsSec5Text: Smoking, vaping, and the use of illegal substances are strictly prohibited inside all Black Suit Car vehicles. All passengers must wear seatbelts in accordance with United States federal and state regulations. An excessive cleaning or damage fee may be charged if the vehicle interior is soiled, vandalized, or damaged by a passenger.
termsSec6Text: The maximum number of passengers and luggage pieces must comply with vehicle safety specifications and the details provided during booking. Black Suit Car and its chauffeurs are not liable for lost, damaged, or forgotten personal items, though our team will make every effort to assist in returning any found belongings promptly.
termsSec7Text: Black Suit Car maintains full commercial vehicle insurance and professional chauffeur licensing in compliance with US laws. Black Suit Car is not liable for travel delays caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond our reasonable control, such as severe weather, natural disasters, road closures, or catastrophic traffic accidents.
termsSec8Text: These Terms & Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United States. For any legal inquiries, contract details, or assistance, please contact our concierge team at info@blacksuitcar.com.
